sections.title: About Freddy Farmer
text: Freddy Farmer is a retro arcade style game with 16-bit pixel art graphics in the style of the 80s/90s where you can test your skills as a player.
Freddy Farmer provides a couple unique twists to classic arcade platformer action.
It’s challenging, cute, old-school, and has a lot of variety so if you’re looking for an arcade-style game.
